methodologyNotes: Covers battery-electric personal mobility scooters (3- and 4-wheel) sold to consumers at a published US MSRP, spanning travel/folding, full-size, and heavy-duty/bariatric classes. Excludes joystick-driven power wheelchairs, manual wheelchairs, and mobility e-bikes. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. wheelCount is the number of ground wheels (3 or 4). topSpeedMph is the manufacturer's maximum forward speed in miles per hour. maxRangeMiles is the rated maximum driving range per full charge in miles (real-world range falls with rider weight, terrain, and incline). weightCapacityLbs is the maximum rated user weight in pounds. motorPowerWatts is the rated motor/transaxle output in watts; null if not disclosed. turningRadiusIn is the tightest turning radius in inches. groundClearanceIn is frame-to-ground clearance in inches; null if not disclosed. totalWeightLbs is the assembled unit weight including batteries in pounds. heaviestPieceLbs is the weight of the heaviest single piece when folded or disassembled for transport, in pounds; null if the unit does not break down. batteryCapacityAh is the amp-hour rating of one battery in Ah (units typically carry two in series). maxClimbAngleDeg is the maximum rated climbing incline in degrees; null if not disclosed. portabilityType is an enum: 'folds', 'disassembles', or 'none'.
